newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks close higher on incentives.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks close higher on incentives.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed higher on Wednesday's settlement day, a day after the government announced an incentives package for capital markets, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.
The KSE's 100-share index closed 20.10 points, or 1.30 percent, higher at 1,561.41 amid 104 gainers and 101 losers in a turnover of 72 million shares.

"The steps taken by the government have much potential to attract local and foreign investment in our market and the market is supposed to remain bullish in the forthcoming sessions," a dealer at Ali Husain Rajabali said.
